title: Copilot cloud agent and code review runs: find recent ones with gh api event=dynamic, filtered by .path rather than workflow name
answers: How do I find the recent Copilot cloud agent setup runs for this repo?
Which gh api query lists the Copilot code review runs and their html_url?
What path string identifies a Copilot cloud agent run versus a code review run in the Actions runs list?
Where is the command for locating dynamic Copilot workflow runs documented?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml and .github/workflows/copilot-code-review.yml carry the lookup query as a comment header; it calls the GitHub Actions runs API (`/repos/mlflow/mlflow/actions/runs?event=dynamic&per_page=100`) and filters `.workflow_runs[]` on `.path`.
Rule: Copilot-launched runs are listed with `event=dynamic`, and they are identified by `.path`, not `.name`: cloud agent is `dynamic/copilot-swe-agent/copilot`; code review is `dynamic/agents/copilot-pull-request-reviewer`. Output fields used are `{id, name, created_at, conclusion, html_url}`.
Constraints: The query reads only the first 100 dynamic runs (`per_page=100`, no pagination shown), so older runs may not appear. It needs `gh` authenticated against mlflow/mlflow. The path strings are the ones written in the workflow comments; if the launcher changes them, the filter returns nothing and the comment must be updated.
applies: Maintainers looking up recent Copilot cloud agent or code review runs in the MLflow repo; does not cover other dynamic or non-Copilot workflow runs.
